subject: Navigator Labs capacity verification & standby reservation request
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T09:15:00Z
Subject: Navigator Labs capacity verification & standby reservation request

Team,

Navigator (deal NV-4721) just signaled intent to commit to a Dedicated pool for Q1 onboarding. They need a firm answer on our near-term availability and whether we can put a short soft-hold on nodes while legal finishes the MLA. High-level ask below — please flag if any of it is infeasible.

- Target start: 2027-01-10 production cutover
- Initial capacity: 12 T4-like GPUs (they are flexible on exact SKU; preference for A100 if available for perf-sensitive routes)
- Run profile: sustained token throughput for chat + embeddings; peak concurrency ~1400 reqs/min for initial ramp
- Commit window: asking for a 21-day soft hold while they complete procurement

Specific asks:
1) Marissa — can you attach the latest fleet snapshot and confirm whether we have 12 node-equivalents available in us-west / dedicated pool margin?
2) Ben — what does ops need to turn a soft-hold into a reserved allocation (lead time, cost uplift, SLA implications)?
3) Monica / Logan — if we place a soft hold, what internal approvals do we need and what ticketing/action should Sales create?

Attaching our internal intake doc will help frame the ask.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ethan_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Navigator Labs capacity verification & standby reservation request

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 09:15 AM Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
>
> Navigator (deal NV-4721) just signaled intent to commit to a Dedicated pool for Q1 onboarding.

Thanks, Ethan — quick inventory snapshot attached (gpu_inventory_snapshot_20261110.csv). TL;DR: we have the raw hardware headroom to cover 12 T4-equivalents in the us-west region for Jan, but there are a few nuances: 

- Available SKUs: 8 x A100-40GB, 10 x T4-class, 6 x A10 (shared pool) — depending on bin-packing we can hit the 12-GPU target by mixing (prefer A100 for low-latency critical routes).
- Contention: two other late-stage deals (not committed) have soft holds that together consume ~6 T4-equivalents in the same region; those holds expire on 2026-11-20 unless extended.
- Ops note: converting nodes from the shared autoscale pool to a Dedicated pool requires draining, reprovisioning, and a maintenance window (~6–12 hours per batch of 4 nodes).

Recommendation: request a "soft-standby" tag on 14 T4-equivalents (buffer + failover) for 21 days. Ops can reserve by adding a hold tag and creating a provisioning ticket. If Navigator insists on specific A100s, we'll need to provision 8x A100 and 4x T4 as a fallback.

Attaching: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20261110.csv

Marissa Cole
Capacity & Supply Planning Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ethan_park@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Navigator Labs capacity verification & standby reservation request

Thanks for the snapshot — good context. Ops standpoint:

- We can implement a soft-hold (tag + no-eviction policy) on 14 T4-equivalents within 24 hours of a formal internal approval ticket.
- To convert to hard reserved Dedicated capacity (with guaranteed throughput and SLA) we need:
  a) signed MLA + capacity commit (or a PO)
  b) 72 hours lead time to reprovision and validate; planning window for A100s is 5 business days if we need to migrate running workloads.
- Cost: soft-hold is operational (no upfront charge) but we should communicate risk that hard-reservation pricing applies once committed. Recommend including a nominal "reservation fee" if customer wants an exclusive lock longer than 21 days.

Operational ask: open an internal ticket in #capacity-ops with the subject "NV-4721 soft-hold request" and include the inventory CSV and deal link. Ops will then tag nodes and update the capacity dashboard.

Ben Carter
Head of Capacity Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20261110.csv]
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha@navigator.ai>
To: ethan_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Navigator Labs capacity verification & standby reservation request

Ethan / Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround. Navigator is ready to move forward with a 21-day soft-hold while our legal and procurement finish the MLA. Two asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood confirm the earliest we can convert the soft-hold to a binding reservation once the MLA is signed? We need a guaranteed window to avoid ramp delays.
2) Please send any paperwork / DocuSign proposal that documents the soft-hold terms (duration, soft vs hard cost implications, cancellation terms).

We'd prefer A100s for production-critical traffic, but can accept a mixed fleet in the ramp period. Please include any expected lead time for A100-specific reprovisioning.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Gupta
VP Product 
Navigator Labs
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: ethan_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Navigator Labs capacity verification & standby reservation request

Looping back with approvals and next steps.

- Internal approvals: I have exec sign-off to place a 21-day soft-standby on up to 14 T4-equivalents in us-west for NV-4721. This is a non-billing tag that prevents reclamation but does not change pricing.
- Ops action: Ben — please create ticket OPS-20261113-78 to add the hold tag and add a note to the dashboard. Confirm when nodes are tagged. Expected ops window for tagging: within 24 hours of ticket creation.
- Commercial follow-up: Ethan — send Navigator the soft-hold terms doc + a DocuSign link. Use the placeholder reservation fee language — legal will fill in if they want an extended/exclusive lock.

Attachments added for outbound: Navigator_MLA_draft_v2.pdf (for legal), and I uploaded the inventory snapshot to the deal in HubSpot.

Thanks all — let's avoid extending existing holds that would block other committed customers. If Aisha pushes for immediate A100 exclusivity, escalate to me and I'll coordinate tradeoffs.

Monica Patel
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
